entities.summary: Morten Steenstrup  was a Norwegian barrister and politician. A member of the Conservative Party, Stenstrup served as a member of the Storting for Vestfold from 1981 to 1989, having previously served as a deputy member from 1977 to 1981. He also served as a state secretary in the Second Willoch cabinet from 1985 to 1986 and was most recently the leader of the Oslo Conservative Party from 2022 to 2024.
